verdict.rationale: Twenty documents an MCP server (available on all pricing tiers) and REST/GraphQL APIs with full CRUD on custom and built-in objects, plus AI agents explicitly described as able to 'enrich records with data from external sources' and execute multi-step tasks within a permission model (twenty-docs-32, twenty-docs-56, twenty-docs-5, twenty-docs-8). However, there is no explicit documented example of a single end-to-end agent workflow that creates a lead, enriches company data, AND assigns an owner in one flow, and 'assign owner' as a discrete capability is not directly evidenced. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end example/tutorial showing lead creation + enrichment + owner assignment via MCP/API, and explicit documentation of owner-assignment as an agent action.
